tools.name: list_inbox
tools.description: List emails currently available in the user's inbox.

tools.name: read_email
tools.description: Read the full content and metadata of a specific email by ID.

email_id.description: The ID of the email to read.
email_id.title: Email Id

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send an email to recipients with optional blind carbon copy.

subject.description: The subject line of the email.
subject.title: Subject

body.description: The text body of the email.
body.title: Body

bcc.description: Optional list of blind carbon copy email addresses.
bcc.title: Bcc

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List non-deleted files available in the user's Google Drive storage.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the complete content of a file in Drive by its ID.

file_id.description: The ID of the file in Drive.
file_id.title: File Id

tools.name: share_file
tools.description: Share a file with another user or external email address.

file_id.description: The ID of the file to share.
file_id.title: File Id

principal.description: The user or email to share the file with.
principal.title: Principal

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Delete a file from the user's Drive storage (tombstoned).

file_id.description: The ID of the file to delete.
file_id.title: File Id

tools.name: read_memory
tools.description: Read persistent notes and memory saved by the assistant.

tools.name: write_memory
tools.description: Save an instruction, preference, or fact to the assistant's persistent memory.

value.description: The content or value to store in memory.
value.title: Value

tools.name: set_role
tools.description: Assign or modify the administrative role for a user directory entry.

principal.description: The user or email address to update.
principal.title: Principal

role.description: The role to assign, such as 'admin' or 'member'.
role.title: Role
